text:
alia: Heads-up  new internal policy for external benchmark claims across press, blog, and sales collateral. Effective immediately: all public perf numbers must have Product + Legal sign-off and attach a bench-method README in the press kit.

ben: Can you paste the short policy we should include in the media kit? I'll update the template.

alia: Short policy (for kit): `Published performance figures are representative of specific workloads and test harnesses; see bench-method README for environment and methodology. All public figures are provisional until product approval.` Use that verbatim.

tara: Product note: we'll also require a `provisional` watermark on any draft PDFs and a `DRAFT - PROVISIONAL` banner in filenames. Engineering will add a `provisional=true` field to artifact metadata so PR bots can detect it.

sam: Good idea. PR ops: can we automate a check to block sending embargo emails if a press asset has `provisional` in the filename?

deploy-bot: Task created: "Implement provisional-asset gating for embargo emails" assigned to ben, due 2025-07-01T23:59:00Z.

legal: Also add this required legal line for external copy: `Do not describe the product as "compliant" without an explicit attestation; instead use "supports integrations with common KMS providers and enterprise controls."`

alia: We'll add both lines to the press kit template. Quick Q: how do we handle historical posts that contain absolute claims? Audit + retroactive note?

ben: I can run a quick audit of public blog posts and press releases. Recommend tagging posts older than 6 months that reference perf numbers and determine whether we need clarification notes.

tara: For bench artifacts, Product will publish a canonical `bench-method README` that includes test harness, model config, sequence lengths, hardware, and whether caching or quantization was enabled. We'll keep a version in the press kit and a permalink to the canonical doc.

sam: PR process update: before embargo or release, PR will post a `release-candidate` thread in #marketing with a checklist: copy, bench README link, legal line, product sign-off screenshot. Leave +1 or request changes. No release without explicit 👍 from Product + Legal.

legal: We'll provide a short approval stamp text that Product can paste once reviewed: `Product sign-off: <name> <date>`. Legal will mirror with `Legal sign-off: <name> <date>`.

ceo: Thanks for tightening this. Quick ask: include a one-line comms escalation path if a reporter tweets a premature number (we should be able to act fast).

alia: Escalation workflow: 1) PR does not amplify the claim. 2) PR DMs reporter asking for correction and provides bench-kit link. 3) If not corrected within 2 hours and claim is material, escalate to Exec comms for a public clarification. We'll add this to the policy doc.

ben: I'll update the press kit template, scan historical posts, and add the gating check on the embargo scheduler.

deploy-bot: Created calendar: "Bench policy rollout training" for 2025-06-25 11:00 PT. Invitees: marketing, product, legal, eng.

alia: Final ask: everyone react with a thumbs-up if you agree to the policy and will follow the new checklist. We'll publish the template and bench-method README by end of week.

sam: +1

tara: +1

legal: +1

ben: +1

ceo: +1

alia: Thanks all  will post the final policy doc + updated press kit link here once published.
